scripts.build: tsc -b packages/* && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/* --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspace web && tsc --noEmit --project packages/domain/tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit --project packages/source-sdk/tsconfig.test.json --pretty false
scripts.python:lint: uv run --project apps/worker ruff check apps/worker
scripts.notices:python:generate: uv run --project apps/worker --with colorama==0.4.6 python evaluations/python_license_inventory.py --output THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.python.json
scripts.notices:python:check: uv run --project apps/worker --with colorama==0.4.6 python evaluations/python_license_inventory.py --check THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.python.json
scripts.inventory:refresh: uv run --project apps/worker python -m reality_ledger_worker.inventory_cli refresh
scripts.inventory:fixture: uv run --project apps/worker python -m reality_ledger_worker.inventory_cli refresh --fixture-only
scripts.metro:generate: uv run --project apps/worker python -m reality_ledger_worker.deep_metro_cli generate
